paragraph: Oakland is a single-family town, and the numbers are not subtle. 53 homes sold over six months at a median of $700,000, with a sale-to-list ratio of 1.06, about 72 percent closing above asking, and a median of 14 days on market. That is a real seller's market with many multiple offer situations. Sales ran from $284,888 to $2,065,000, so the median is a better guide than the average. Volume built into June and July at 14 and 12 closings, and the July median of $865,500 is the highest month of the run, so this market is still climbing into the summer peak. If Oakland follows the usual Bergen arc, expect medians to ease as fall closings come in. Condo and townhouse activity was two sales, too thin to read. Buy here for the space and grounds, and come prepared to move quickly.
